note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #5, Q2 2025 Public Safety Perception) keeps the 53 INEGI columns bp1_1..bp1_9_6 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0625.csv (import delimited case(lower)), incl. bp1_6_1..bp1_6_8, and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's 2025 Q2 data dictionary labels every BP1_* column (e.g. BP1_2_08 'Percepcion de seguridad en el cajero automatico localizado en la via publica'; BP1_5_4 'Cambiar sus habitos respecto a permitir que los (las) menores de edad que viven en el hogar salgan solos(as) por temor a sufrir algun delito'; BP1_6_7 'Victima perteneciente al hogar de fraude bancario'; BP1_6_8 'Victima perteneciente al hogar de fraude al consumidor'; BP1_9_5 'Percepcion del grado de confianza en la Fuerza Aerea Mexicana'); 53/53 labels name the same place/situation/authority as the questionnaire sub-item/row carrying the same number, and 132/132 shipped option_text values are character-identical to the catalogos/<item>.csv label for that code. Step 3b, 2025 Q2 vs 2025 Q1 vs 2024 Q2 (checked against the 2025 Q2 print, 0625 dictionary, catalogos, raw columns and .do, not assumed): 2025 Q2 Section I is the Q2/Q4 form -- 1.6 is household victimization in the last six months over Tarjeta-A incidences (bp1_6_1..8, 1=Si/2=No/9), NOT 2025 Q1's 14-indicator news-source checklist (bp1_6_01..13, 99). Versus 2024 Q2 (batch_679, 51 items): (a) 1.6 adds incidences 7 'Alguien uso su chequera, numero de tarjeta o cuenta bancaria ... (fraude bancario) o le dio dinero falso' and 8 'Entrego dinero por un producto o un servicio que no recibio conforme a lo acordado (fraude al consumidor)' (p.2; .do comment 'items 7-8 added in 2025'; 0625 dictionary adds BP1_6_7/BP1_6_8), and the 18+ scope direction now reads 'CODIGOS DE DELITO 4, 5, 6, 7 Y 8' -- same as 2024 Q4 (batch_688); (b) 1.5 item 4 carries the rewording 'permitir que los (las) menores de edad que viven en el hogar salgan solos(as)?' (print and dictionary; 2024 Q2 'permitir que salgan de su vivienda sus hijos(as) menores?'), as in 2024 Q3/Q4 and 2025 Q1. NEW IN 2025 Q2, not in any earlier quarter checked (2024 Q1/Q2, 2025 Q1 prints): two 1.2 place options are reworded in the PRINT (p.2, confirmed on a 110-dpi render): 03 'la calle' (earlier 'las calles que habitualmente usa') and 12 'el parque o centro recreativo (lugar fisico publico con areas verdes, areas de juegos, senderos o caminos, lagos o fuentes, o con instalaciones deportivas, culturales o educativas)' (earlier 'el parque recreativo o centro recreativo'). The 0625 dictionary still carries the old labels for BP1_2_03 ('...las calles que habitualmente usa') and BP1_2_12 ('...el parque recreativo o centro recreativo'); same referent, same code, so the mapping is unaffected; shipped the administered print wording. Dictionary diff 0624 vs 0625 over BP1: only BP1_5_4 (above) and the added BP1_6_7/BP1_6_8; all 51 shared catalogos/bp1_*.csv byte-identical after line-ending normalisation. The 2025 Q1 1.7 interviewer direction is replaced by 'PASE AL SIGUIENTE RENGLON / SI EN TODOS LOS CASOS LA RESPUESTA ES IGUAL A CODIGO 2, 3 O 9 PASE A LA SECCION II' (stripped either way). Words: text_source=study_materials, the administered 2025 Q2 questionnaire wording (not the terser dictionary labels): all 68 distinct Spanish strings shipped (CP1 intro, 7 stems, 1.1/1.3 items, sub-items/rows, option labels) are exact substrings of pdftotext -raw output of pp.2-3 after whitespace/dot-leader normalisation, and 110-dpi renders of pp.2-3 were read to confirm. Structure and conventions identical to batch_679/batch_688: CP1 read-aloud intro in instructions; one section_id per question 1.1-1.9; for 1.2 and 1.4-1.9 the stem is in section_prompt and the sub-item/row in item_text; 1.1 and 1.3 are single items with the stem in item_text. Kept as printed: '(LUGAR)', '(CIUDAD)', '(AUTORIDAD)', '(CODIGO DE LA INCIDENCIA)', 'la (al)', 'la (del)', 'la (el)' fills; '(a)'/'(as)' gender fills; trailing '?' and '...'; 1.1/1.3 options with trailing '?'; '[CDMX (3)]' row label on bp1_7_1; 'Otro' write-in row (bp1_5_5) as the bare word. Normalised: line wraps joined. Stripped: question/option numbers, dot leaders, entry boxes, blank write-in lines, 'ESPECIFIQUE', interviewer directions (CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO; REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION; MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'A' Y REGISTRE...; PASE AL SIGUIENTE RENGLON; the 1.7 all-2/3/9 skip note; APLIQUE 1.8 Y 1.9 PARA CADA CODIGO 1 REGISTRADO EN 1.7; and the two 1.6 scope directions 'PARA LOS CODIGOS DE DELITO 1 Y 2 UNICAMENTE SE DEBERA CONSIDERAR AQUELLOS VEHICULOS QUE SON PROPIEDAD DEL HOGAR' and 'PARA LOS CODIGOS DE DELITO 4, 5, 6, 7 Y 8 UNICAMENTE SE DEBERA CONSIDERAR A LAS PERSONAS INTEGRANTES DEL HOGAR DE 18 ANOS Y MAS' -- disclosed in public_note). Tarjeta A is not in the questionnaire zip; 1.6 item_text is the printed questionnaire row. Options: only levels present in the live data get rows (no row for 3 'No aplica' / 9 'No sabe / no responde', set missing by the .do); every level each item's respondents used has an option row (132/132 live item x level cells). Cross-check (route 9 style, .cache/mexico_2025_q2safety_perception/counts.py vs live_counts.csv from a server-side GROUP BY item,resp query; no export): all 132/132 live item x level counts equal the raw 2025 Q2 file after the .do's recodes (e.g. bp1_1 1/2 = 9392/14290, bp1_2_03 1/2 = 9143/14316, bp1_2_12 1/2 = 11000/8888, bp1_3 1..4 = 6034/4072/7410/5949, bp1_6_7 1/2 = 1477/22236, bp1_6_8 1/2 = 1101/22613, bp1_9_1 1..4 = 1128/6276/4148/3422). Live COUNT(*) = 1,112,407 = expected long rows from the .do; COUNT(DISTINCT id) = 23,717 = raw respondents; 0 duplicate id x item; 0 missing resp. NOT truncated (cf. the 1,048,575-row cut in 2025 Q1, batch_692). Dictionary defects: Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q2 wave (file suffix 0625) -- same as the siblings; Description ('Urban safety perception ratings ... Q2 2025') does not mention that 1.6 is household crime victimization. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation): reused verbatim from batch_688 (2024 Q4; itself batch_675/679 English plus bp1_5_4 and bp1_6_7/8) for every string whose Spanish is identical; translated fresh only for the two reworded 1.2 options bp1_2_03 ('the street') and bp1_2_12 ('the park or recreation center (a public physical place with green areas, ...)'). INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, segundo trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section I (questions 1.1-1.9) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions (including the 1.6 notes limiting vehicle thefts to household-owned vehicles and incidents 4-8 to household members aged 18+), and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
